what: G-55 (HoQ report 505599e..96aaf91): built battery binaries. launchEvidenceTool runs a tool only if its real path and sha256 equal an entry here and the entry's source pin equals tool-pins-v1.1.json (frozen; rule 15). No binary is built yet, so the list is empty and every launch is refused (fail-closed). An entry is added only when a binary is built from the pinned source, recording the build.
